description: Finds verses containing ALL the given words in one edition. Words match as substrings, so a stem finds its forms ("forgiv" finds forgive, forgiven, forgiveness). Put a phrase in double quotes to match it exactly. Search the edition in the language of the words: osen for English, osnb/osnn for Norwegian, sblgnt/tanach for Greek/Hebrew spellings.

book.description: Limit to one book, by name or abbreviation in any language, e.g. "John", "Joh" or "Sal". Default: the whole Bible.

edition.description: Edition to search, in the language of the words: osen (English), osnb (Norwegian Bokmål), osnn (Norwegian Nynorsk), sblgnt (Greek), tanach (Hebrew). Default: osen.

language.description: Language for names, notes and study content, and for the links to bible.flogvit.com: en (English), nb (Norwegian Bokmål), nn (Norwegian Nynorsk), sv (Swedish), fr (French), es (Spanish), fi (Finnish), de (German). Content missing in a language falls back to English. Default: en.

mapping.description: Verse numbering to give the verse references in: a mapping id from list_verse_mappings, e.g. "english_kj" (King James) or "dnb2024_nb", or a short name such as "kjv". Default: osnb, the site's own numbering.

offset.description: How many verses to skip, for the next page: pass the offset the previous answer names. Default: 0.

query.description: Words to find, e.g. `forgiv sins` or `"love one another"`.

testament.description: Limit to the Old (OT) or New (NT) Testament. Ignored when book is given. Default: both.

name: search_bible
title: Search the Bible text
